native_construction_policy: Construct a native hop definition only when the source values present can satisfy the native schema without repair. BeerJSON-defined information that is not natively interpreted remains separately source-preserved for compatibility.

field_mappings.reverse: Use the native name when unchanged; otherwise prefer retained BeerJSON source text.
Map producer_name back to BeerJSON producer; preserve an empty source string separately rather than manufacturing a non-empty native value.
Map product_identifier back to BeerJSON product_id; preserve an empty source string separately when present.
Map origin_text back to BeerJSON origin without interpreting it as a structured geography.
Re-emit the retained BeerJSON year string exactly. BeerJSON does not define whether this string is crop year, harvest year, production year, or another label.
Reverse the explicit one-to-one token map; do not treat source spelling as the native vocabulary identifier.
Reconstruct BeerJSON PercentType from the retained reported percentage value and '%' token.
Reconstruct BeerJSON PercentType from the retained reported percentage value and '%' token.

non_inferences: Do not infer a mass-fraction reporting basis for alpha_acid or beta_acid merely because brewing convention commonly uses mass percentages.
Do not interpret BeerJSON year as crop_year, harvest_year, or production_year without additional source semantics.
Do not force BeerJSON empty strings into native fields that require meaningful non-empty text; preserve the source representation instead.
